senses.gloss:
पीव, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to Sāy.) = आ-प्या-
यित, fat.

पीव पीव, पीवन्, पीवर, पीवस्, पीवस,
पीविष्ठ. See col. 2.

पीवा पीवा, f. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पा),
water.

पीवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fat; (probably the original
form of पीवन् below.)

पीवन्, आ, अरी, अ, swelling, full, fat, large; stout,
strong, robust; (आ), m. wind; (अरी), f. Asparagus
Racemosus, Desmodium Gangeticum (= शाल-पर्-
णी); N. of a spiritual daughter of the Barhi-shad
Pitṛs; of the wife of Veda-śiras; of a princess of
Vi-darbha.

पीवर, अस्, आ, or ई, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 1. पा),
fat, stout, large, fleshy, corpulent, plump, thick,
dense; (अस्), m. a tortoise; N. of one of the Sap-
tarshis under Manu Tāmasa; (आ), f. Physalis Flex-
uosa, Asparagus Racemosus; N. of a daughter of the
Gandharva Huhu; (ई), f. a young woman; a cow;
[cf. Gr. πιαρό-ς, πιερό-ς, πιαλέο-ς, πίειρα.];
—पी-
वर-त्व, अम्, n. fatness, thickness, largeness, heavi-
ness, density.
—पीवर-स्तनी, f. a woman with large
breasts; a cow with a large udder.
—पीवरी-कृ, cl.
8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to fatten, make
fat.
—पीवरी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, fattened.

पीवस्, आन्, असी, अस् (a kindred form to पीवन्),
fat, stout; (अस्), n., Ved. fat; [cf. Zend pivanh,
‘fat;’ Gr. πῖαρ.]
—पीव-स्फाक, अस्, आ, अम् (for
पीवस्-स्फाक), Ved. swelling with fat.
—पीवस्-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. abounding with, swollen.
—पीवो-अन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having rich or
abundant food.
—पीवो-अश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having
fat horses.
—पीवोपवसन (˚व-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. covered with fat; (according to Mahī-dhara)
near to fat or fleshy parts of the body.

पीवस, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. abounding with fat, fat,
abundant; swelling, swollen, inflated; (Sāy.) = पीन,
robust; = अ-च्छिन्न, untorn.
पीविष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, extremely fat.

पीव् पीव्, cl. 1. P. पीवति, पीवितुम्, to be
fat or corpulent, to be thick.
